'''Mab Kador''' was an [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who competed in a retrofitted [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] that he had named the ''[[White Panther]]''.<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]</ref> Kador had won his past three races when he took part in a fourth [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] held at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While remotely [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewing]] part of the race, the [[Youngling/Legends|young]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] recognized Kador from his racing profile. During the race, Fett thought Kador looked young and hungry but still wanted him to win.<ref name="Hunted" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mab Kador appeared in ''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]'', the fourth book in the young-reader ''[[Star Wars: Boba Fett]]'' series. The book was written by [[Elizabeth Hand]] and released in [[2003]].<ref name="Hunted" />
